sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: Nobody. Show the Fascists your thumb.

sections.label: YOUR POWER
items: At Call Special Election, once the President names a pick, you may reveal and become President instead.
You and the outgoing President each name a Chancellor candidate.
Everyone hands a ballot card to their choice. Most cards wins, you break ties.

rulebook.title: The Monarchist
rulebook.pitch: A Fascist who wants the board, not Hitler. Splits the Fascist team and can seize the presidency at Special Election.

details.label: Goal
text: You are far right, but you play for your own goal. You win when the Fascist board is full or when Hitler is executed. You lose if Hitler is elected Chancellor after the 3rd Fascist policy: the Fascists win then, but you do not.

details.label: What you know
text: Nobody. At setup you keep your eyes closed and show a thumb, so the Fascists (not Hitler) know who you are. You do not learn who the Fascists or Hitler are.

details.label: Power
text: There is only ever one President. When a President uses Call Special Election and names the next presidential candidate, you may reveal your Secret Role card. You then become the next President instead of that player.

The Chancellor is chosen differently in that round. You and the outgoing President (the one who called the Special Election) each name a Chancellor candidate. Every player hands one ballot card to the candidate they back, and the candidate with the most cards becomes Chancellor. If there is a tie, you decide. Then the legislative session goes on as usual.
The round after, the President placard returns to the left of the President who called the Special Election, as after any Special Election.

details.label: Danger
text: You want Fascist policies but not Hitler in power, so you have to find Hitler without help: the Fascists know you, but they will not tell you who Hitler is. Every time a Chancellor is elected after the 3rd Fascist policy, you could lose.

details.label: How to play it
text: Push Fascist policies, but block any Chancellor you suspect of being Hitler, and steer executions towards him. Save your power for the government that matters most.
